content.short: Rise Wallet is a leading high-performance self-custody wallet designed for the Aptos and Sui ecosystems.
content.description: Rise Wallet is a premier decentralized wallet natively built to provide users with a secure and intuitive gateway to the Move-based ecosystems of Aptos and Sui. As a self-custody solution, Rise ensures that users maintain full control over their private keys and digital assets while enjoying a seamless experience across diverse dApps. The wallet features a suite of built-in tools for asset management, NFT discovery, and direct integration with the networks' leading DeFi protocols. Rise Wallet focuses on security, performance, and accessibility, making it an essential component for both new and experienced users navigating the rapidly expanding high-throughput Layer 1 landscape, ensuring a frictionless Web3 experience.
content.meta: Rise Wallet is the leading self-custody wallet for Aptos and Sui, offering secure asset management and seamless integration with the Move ecosystem.
